# Contributing

Thank you for taking the time to contribute. All contributions are welcome.

To contribute, follow these steps:

1. Open [New issue](https://github.com/nukeratframework/armory/issues/new/choose) and select **Armory contribution**.
2. Fill in the required fields.
3. Fork the repository, create a **branch** from `main`, do not commit on your fork `main`, and open a PR into `main` on `nukeratframework/armory`.

## Requirements

- No compiled artifacts in the tree
- The tool license allows redistribution
